source_title: SVKM NMIMS Global University, Dhule official homepage
content: SVKM NMIMS Global University, Dhule is a state-private university in Maharashtra. The official homepage lists the main academic areas as School of Commerce, School of Technology, Management and Engineering, and School of Pharmacy and Technology Management.
